locations.title: 06 - Damned Yanki
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've encountered Mr. Shakedown and the objective is to head home.

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows:
  - "Hello in English" / "Start your engines!"
  - "Fighting every day" / "Rescuing puppies"
  - "The time you crushed a gang" / "Stay silent"

**Reward:**
- Wild Shirt (gear) - for three best answers chosen
- Charismatic Autobiography (accessory) - for two best answers chosen
- Charismatic Photo (accessory) - for one best answer chosen
- Krazy Kyo (Business Advisor)

locations.title: 07 - How to Train Your Dominatrix
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [09 - The Show Must Go On](#loc=940035)

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your choices. 
- Route A:
  - "Who gave you permission to speak, pig!?"
  - "I want to be humiliated."
  - "I bet you'd like that, you pervert!"
  - "They're watching you get humiliated!"
- Route B:
  - "It's not like I'm happy to see you or anything!"
  - "I want to be stepped on with heels."
  - "Gross! I'm the only who would do that for you!"
  - "Keep your eyes on me, and me alone!"

**Reward:**
- Fur Belly Warmer (accessory) - Reward for Route A
- Collapsible Steel Staff (weapon) - Reward for Route B
- Toughness Z (consumable) - Reward for a mix of A and B
- Masochistic Man (Business Advisor)

locations.title: 08 - Password Protected
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've encountered Mr. Shakedown and the objective is to head home.

**Tips:**
- When speaking to the woman, mention "Plans for today" and "Tomorrow's weather"
- When speaking to the man, mention "A movie date" and "Rain at noon"
- The password is a case-sensitive "Subotenuhigeukiro"

**Reward:**
- Access to the [Black Market Dealer](#loc=939951)'s stock
- Li Leung (Security Staff)

locations.title: 09 - The Show Must Go On
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress the story until you've encountered Mr. Shakedown and the objective is to head home.

**Tips:**
- The "Erasable" is food
- To "Grocer" is to tilt it at an angle
- To "Jeer" and "strike the set" is to remove the dish.

**Reward:**
- Magnetic Necklace (accessory) - if you performed the correct actions
- Tauriner+ (consumable) - if you did not
